AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S industrializes leading-edge technologies for its core business segments Mobile Devices & Substrates, Automotive & Aerospace, Industrial and Medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference.

 

To enhance our successful PE/CAM Team in Leoben, Austria, we are looking for a passionate 1 Senior Engineer PE/ CAM Systems n your role, you will drive the development, optimization, and global management of PE/CAM systems across AT&S. You will ensure high system availability, process automation, and the continuous improvement of engineering and CAM applications. 

Your Responsibilities 

 * Manage, maintain, and further develop PE/CAM systems such as Engenix, UcamX, Integr8tor, Genesis2000, and InCAM-PRO.

 * Develop, modify, and optimize software solutions and automation processes within the PE/CAM environment.

 * Analyze system performance and troubleshoot technical issues to ensure stable and efficient operations.

 * Define and maintain development, documentation, and system standards.

 * Coordinate and support key users, providing training and guidance on PE/CAM systems and processes.

 * Plan, test, validate, and document system enhancements and development projects.

 * Act as the main contact for IT-related topics and collaborate with external system providers on future developments.

 * Maintain Azure DevOps environments, including repositories and CI/CD pipelines. 

Your Profile 

 * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

 * Experience in software development and system management within a technical or manufacturing environment.

 * Good knowledge of Java, Perl, Delphi Pascal, and relational databases such as MySQL or T-SQL.

 * Experience with Azure DevOps and modern web technologies such as Spring and Vue.

 * Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, operating systems, and network fundamentals.

 * Knowledge of PE/CAM systems and manufacturing engineering processes is an advantage.

 * Strong analytical, problem-solving, and customer-oriented mindset with excellent teamwork skills.

 * Good English skills and willingness to travel internationally. 

Our Offer 

 * A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment 

 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value 

 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day

 * Free parking spaces and e-charging stations

 * Diverse health measures and a wide range of employee benefits 

Ready for a new challenge to advance your career? It's just a click to apply online. We look forward to your application and your detailed resume. Your AT&S Team!

At Lam Research, we create equipment that drives technological advancements in the semiconductor industry. Our innovative solutions enable chipmakers to power progress in nearly all aspects of modern life, and it takes each member of our team to make it possible.

Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. We strive to create an inclusive and diverse culture where everyone s contribution and voice has value. We evaluate and evolve our offerings, so our people receive the support and empowerment to do meaningful things for their lives, careers, and communities.

Because at Lam, we believe that when people are the priority and they re inspired to unleash the power of innovation for a better world together, anything is possible. 1 Process Engineer (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500

REQ ID: 200982

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 * Responsible for performing professional process engineering research, development and evaluation in semiconductor environment

 * Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication and evaluation of products including in-house lab demonstrations

 * Conceives and plans projects involving definition and selection of new concepts and approaches

 * Works with customer and senior engineers cross functionally to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues/ challenges.

 * Acts as customer technology manager in the planning, data collection, analysis and reporting

 * Acts as single point of contact accountable for process related customer requests

 * Drives introduction and evaluation of new technologies at customer sites including new tool qualification

Other Job Responsibilities

 * Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements

 * Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results needed

 * Flexibility to travel to meet business requirements

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 * MSc in in Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering or Physics with with no previous professional experience; or equivalent experience preferably in the field of wet clean/advanced packaging 

 * Familiarity with working in a chemical laboratory, having experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques

 * In-depth understanding and experience in Statistical Process Control (SPC) and Design of Experiments (DOE)

 * Excellent social skills with ability to work within diverse teams

 * Creative thinking and strong problem-solving capabilities, able to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment with competing priorities

 * Excellent oral and written communication skills and presentation skills in English

WHAT WE ARE OFFERING

This position is subject to the https://www.metalltechnischeindustrie.at/fileadmin/content/Dokumente/Kollektivvertrag/KV-2025_2026/FMTI_Mindestgehaltstabelle_2026.pdf in the occupation group F depending on educational background. jobs.description: 1 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems - JOB ID: 268343  * As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV. * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures. * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components. * You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools. * You define power-stage architectures, including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures. * You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration. * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines. * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware. * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues. * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders. * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field. *  Experience in power electronic systems * Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies. * Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management. * Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred) * Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems. * Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis * Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems * business-fluent English ; German skills are a nice to have. What to expect: * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 61.334,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions (incl. Home-Office) and individual training and career opportunities. * Mentorship and training in embedded firmware and power systems * The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge power converter technologies in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment. At Raiffeisen Bank International, we are pleased to have more than 17 million customers in Austria and 12 other CEE countries - what got us here, are our talented people. From the moment you join RBI, you will notice our commitment to creating a working environment where everyone can thrive. Diversity and inclusion are essential components of our vision and mission and are reflected in our values: collaboration, proactivity, learning and responsibility. Our shared mission is to provide a superior customer experience by tackling new issues such as digitalization and changing needs. 
We are looking for 1 Internship (f/m/x) - Corporate Development & M&A (38,5h/week) In Group Strategy, our Corporate Development & M&A team combines strategic thinking with hands-on transaction experience. We develop strategic options for the RBI Group and its subsidiaries and support their implementation through acquisitions, divestments and other strategic initiatives. Our work also includes market and competitive analyses as well as strategic projects across the Group.

Are you passionate about Corporate Development and M&A and looking to gain hands-on experience in an international banking environment? We are looking for a motivated Intern (f/m/x) to join our team starting in January 2027.

 

At a glance

 * Start date: January 2027

 * Duration: 6 month Full-time (38.5 h/week)

 * Important: As part of your application, please upload your high school leaving certificate (Matura certificate) and your most recent university transcript of records 

Your role with us on the team

 * Support the preparation and execution of M&A transactions, including acquisitions and divestments

 * Assist with company valuations, including DDM, trading comparables and transaction comparables

 * Conduct market, industry and competitive analyses to support strategic and transaction-related projects

 * Prepare presentations, analyses and decision-making materials for the RBI Board and senior management

 * Perform research on banking and financial markets across the CEE region

 * Contribute to strategic projects and initiatives within Corporate Development & M&A

 

This job is made for you, if...

 * You are an active student at a university or university of applied sciences, ideally majoring in business administration, economics, finance, mathematics or a related field

 * You have a strong interest in Corporate Development, M&A, banking, finance and capital markets

 * You have strong analytical skills, a structured approach and the ability to quickly understand complex topics

 * You are proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint

 * You are proactive, curious and enjoy challenging the status quo and contributing your own ideas

 * You work independently and reliably while enjoying collaboration in an international team

 * You have an excellent command of English; German and/or a CEE language is an advantage

 * Experience with Bloomberg, Capital IQ or similar financial databases is a plus

What's in it for you?

 * Work & Study: gain experience in the international banking environment & boost the balance of your bank account

 * Flexibility: adapt your working hours to your university schedule 

 * Onboarding: enjoy an easy start - a buddy from your team will take you along

 * Community: network internally with other students 

 * Canteen: healthy, tasty, and heavily subsidized

 * Corporate Benefits: shopping vouchers from the staff council (e.g., supermarkets), free museum tickets, attractive sports offers, reduced fitness center membership, reduced public transport pass etc.

 * We pay an attractive monthly student salary of gross EUR 2,619.73 (on a basis of 38.5 hours)
